description: Travis Kalanick, Ben Horowitz, and Erik Torenberg reunite to reflect on Uber's early days, the investment that almost happened, and why Kalanick believes the next great technology opportunity lies beyond software. They discuss the lessons of building Uber, the value of founder-led companies, and why Kalanick spent nearly eight years quietly building Atoms before stepping back into the spotlight. classificationReason: Substantively discusses industrial AI, robotics, autonomy, mining, food production, and digitizing the physical world.
qualityReason: Extended founder-focused conversation with strategic and operational analysis of industrial technology.
